entities.summary: Tyler Andrew Holt is an American college baseball coach and former professional baseball outfielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Cleveland Indians and Cincinnati Reds between 2014 and 2016, and is currently the outfielding and base running coach for the Boston College Eagles.
